title: Barrhell
description:
Barrhell is a short yet challenging game where the player finds themselves stuck in an evil barrel, transformed into a demon at the bottom of a cave system and needs to escape using their newfound form. Jump, and spin the character with precision, launch the barrel by shooting and attaching the tail to objects. Just don't fall along the way! Can you escape and find freedom?

Flick the mouse to move the barrel!

Shoot and charge your tail to launch the barrel!

Perfectly land on either end of the barrel to stop moving and regain control!

Inspired by Getting Over It with Bennet Foddy.
description_short: In this challenging ordeal, a man cursed by an evil barrel must use his newfound form to escape a mysterious cave and earn his freedom.
